string.text: Listen, what was that in general, there, on the burnt farmstead?

One of many spatial anomalies. With their help, you can cover huge distances in the blink of an eye, but you need to be careful, sometimes they can move you to a dangerous place. Teleportation can be controlled to some extent with a "Compass".
A compass? Any compass, or am I missing something?

No, I mean the artifact. it's not surprising you haven't heard of it, because they have not been found for a long time... But I have one. You helped me a lot, so you can take it for yourself as a token of gratitude.
